universeNote: BSE 1000 core (reference scanned set) + NSE/BSE liquidity extension, 1384 symbols

conditions.label: Valuation
conditions.short: Trailing P/E against the universe, in bands.
conditions.detail: The stock's trailing P/E (Screener.in, refreshed weekly) is ranked against every other scanned name. The cheapest 45% read Undervalued, the next band up to 73% reads Reasonably valued, and the richest 27% read Overvalued. Names with no P/E — losses, blank filings — read N/A and cannot pass.

conditions.label: Earnings Power
conditions.short: Profit growth and returns on equity, together.
conditions.detail: Strong requires trailing-twelve-month profit growth of at least 22% AND return on equity of at least 8%. Both come from the weekly fundamentals cache. Either falling short — or missing filings — reads Weak.

conditions.label: Momentum
conditions.short: Near its 52-week high AND a strong six-month return.
conditions.detail: Each session every scanned name is ranked, cross-sectionally, on two features: how close its close sits to its 250-session high, and its 126-session return. The two ranks are averaged; roughly the top quarter of the market reads Strong momentum and roughly the top six percent reads Very Strong momentum. Names with short tapes read Weak rather than guessing.

conditions.label: Price Contraction
conditions.short: ATR% below its own six-month norm.
conditions.detail: The 14-session ATR as a percentage of price, divided by its own median over the last 120 sessions. At or below a calibrated multiple of that norm, day ranges are shrinking relative to their recent behaviour — supply and demand are agreeing on smaller increments.

conditions.label: Timeframe Alignment
conditions.short: The Minervini trend template, clause by clause.
conditions.detail: On the daily tape: close above the 50-, 150- and 200-day averages, the 50 above the 150, the 200-day average rising over the last twenty sessions, the close at least 1.3× its 52-week low, and no further than 25% below its 52-week high. Every clause must hold; one miss fails the condition.

conditions.label: Outperformance
conditions.short: Twelve-month return ahead of the index.
conditions.detail: The 252-session return minus the Nifty 50's over the same span, cleared by a small calibrated margin so noise around zero does not pass. Positive means the name beat the index it competes with for capital.

conditions.label: Institutional Candles
conditions.short: High-volume bullish days in the last twenty sessions.
conditions.detail: A candle qualifies when it closes up, closes in the top two-thirds of its range, and trades at least nine times its 50-day average volume — the footprint of size leaning on the offer. The reading is the count over the last twenty sessions; anything above zero passes.

conditions.label: Short-term Extension
conditions.detail: Fails when RSI(14) reaches 87 or the close stands 5.5 ATRs above the 20-day average — a pullback-prone stretch. It passes almost every name almost every night, which is the point: when it does fail, it matters.

conditions.label: Long-term Extension
conditions.detail: Fails when the close stands 30% or more above its 50-day average. Vertical moves mean-revert before bases can form; the condition refuses to score them while they last.

conditions.label: Stage Analysis
conditions.detail: Price above a rising 40-week average reads Stage 2 - Uptrend and passes. Price below a falling one reads Stage 4 - Downtrend. Everything in between — above a flat average, below a rising one — reads Not Confirmed and fails until it resolves.

conditions.label: Dow Theory (W)
conditions.detail: A close above the 40-week average reads Uptrend and passes; a close below a falling one reads Downtrend. Mixed states — below a flat or rising average — read Sideways and fail. On weekly data the 40-week average is slow enough to ignore most swing noise.

lede: Breadth improved into the close: 97 names now clear nine of eleven conditions — 2 more than yesterday.
sub: 157 stocks upgraded against 60 downgraded and 1162 did not move. 12 crossed into 9+ versus 10 that left, so the top tier gained ground, concentrated in Industrials and Diversified.

reads.breadth: Over 270 sessions the count at 9+ has ranged from 17 to 140. Today's 97 sits in the 82nd percentile of that range.
reads.movers: 157 stocks gained at least one condition and 60 lost at least one. Of those, 12 crossed into the top tier and 10 dropped out of it.
reads.cond: Outperformance broke on 9 names — the single biggest driver of today's 60 downgrades. Price Contraction was regained on 47, behind part of the 157 upgrades. Short-term Extension passed almost every stock, so tonight's score really separates on the other 10.
reads.sector: Energy leads on mean score at 6.14; Diversified trails at 3.72.
